source.title: Pathogenic role of basic calcium phosphate crystals in destructive arthropathies
source.whyItFits: Open paper that names hydroxyapatite among basic calcium phosphate crystals and links them to osteoarthritis, calcific tendinitis, acute arthritis, and Milwaukee shoulder. A rotator-cuff calcific-tendinopathy review did not use the word hydroxyapatite and was not the primary source.
